_readme: USD per 1 million tokens. Keys are '<provider>:<model>' and must match the model names in .env.local (for Azure, the *_PRICING_KEY values). The dashboard shows a warning banner while any price used by a logged call is 0. cache_write is Anthropic's prompt-cache write fee (OpenAI and Azure have none). Re-check every price before you quote a number to anyone.
_checked_on: 2026-11-03 (Anthropic rows and OpenAI embedding row only; verify on the pricing pages. Azure and OpenAI chat rows are unfilled)
_note_models: The what-if panel lists every chat model here. Embedding models have output = 0 by design; zeroPricedKeys() only checks their input price.
